facts.fact: The Grand Lome autonomous district (DAGL) presented on 17 December 2025 the feasibility study of a modernised addressing project to give every street a code and every home an official number, covering 5,000 km of roads and 538,000 doors across 13 communes.

TGO.note: Document states nothing on authentication services.
Document states nothing on a civil register to ID link.
Document gives no national ID enrolment count or share.
Document states nothing on an ID number at birth.
Document states nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Document states no public register keyed on the national ID number; the physical address in digital identity is only an aim.
Document states nothing on the national ID system itself.
Document states nothing on local government office connections.
